neighbours.label: opening of an embedded clause after a naming/identifying verb: ' what' / ' which' / relative ' that' introducing what a thing is or is called (say what it is, identify which one)
fire: On the worksheet, children must circle each picture and write what it is called.
Ask your guide to tell you what each of the carved symbols means.
The quiz shows a bird photo and you have to name which species it belongs to.
Put a sticker on every box so movers can tell what is inside.
The botanist pointed at the flower and explained what family it comes from.
Can anyone identify which plant this strange seed came from?
Label every drawer with a card saying what it holds.
The museum card beside the tool describes what it was used for.
quiet: On the worksheet, children must circle each picture and color it in.
Ask your guide to take you past each of the carved symbols.
The quiz shows a bird photo and you have to click the next button.
Put a sticker on every box so movers can carry them carefully.
The botanist pointed at the flower and smiled at the students.
Can anyone water this strange seed before the weekend?
Label every drawer with a bright yellow card.
The museum card beside the tool is printed in large letters.

notes: Card: ' that' x7, 'を' x6, ' what', ' identify'; probe: 'say what it is called' 0.47, 'identify the tree it came from' 0.30.
